title: Which script produces this output?
examObjective: Applying correct syntax to write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order, and filter data
prompt:
Given the payload below, **which script produces exactly this output?**

```
["A-1", "C-3"]
```

Only one of the four does. The others are each wrong in a different way.

explanation.approach: Three things have to be right at once — which rows survive, what order they come back in, and which field you keep — and each wrong option gets exactly one of them wrong. That is what a well-built multiple-choice question does: it separates the three decisions so a near-miss tells you which one you got wrong.

snippets.label: The answer
snippets.note: Keep the rows over 25, put them in `sku` order, take the `sku`.

snippets.label: Ordering by the wrong field
snippets.note: The right rows, the wrong order. Ordering by `qty` puts 30 before 40, so C-3 comes first. The data was chosen so `sku` order and `qty` order disagree — if they agreed, this would not be a distractor at all, it would be a second correct answer.

snippets.label: The boundary, off by one row
snippets.note: `>=` lets B-2 in at exactly 20. Boundary conditions are the most common real mistake and the most common exam distractor.

snippets.label: The right rows, the wrong field
snippets.note: Everything correct up to the last step. Note these are Numbers, not Strings — the output does not even have the right type, which is often the quickest way to eliminate an option under time pressure.
